test: writes call the setter > compound assignment, ++ and -- run the getter then the setter
code:
const log = []
        const o = { n: 1, get x() { log.push("get"); return this.n }, set x(v) { log.push("set " + v); this.n = v } }
        o.x += 5
        const post = o.x++
        const pre = ++o["x"]
        o.x--
        return [post, pre, o.n, log]

        o.x ??= 4
        return [o.v, sets]

test: enumeration never calls accessors > keys, for...in, in, hasOwnProperty, delete and console.log
code:
let calls = 0
        const o = { a: 1, get b() { calls++; return 2 }, set c(v) { calls++ }, get d() { calls++ }, set d(v) {} }
        const seen = []
        for (const k in o) seen.push(k)
        console.log(o)
        const r = [Object.keys(o), seen, "b" in o, o.hasOwnProperty("b"), delete o.a, calls]
        return r
